question: Should OpenClaw core own a durable orchestration workflow that invokes Pi and Review services and performs private git promotion, or should this workflow remain in an owner repository or plugin behind existing seams?
rationale: This is a new product and ownership boundary involving persisted workflow state, service contracts, authentication, and promotion behavior; that direction cannot be selected safely from the branch alone.

options.title: Keep the workflow outside core
options.body: Route service-specific orchestration and contracts to the appropriate owner repository or plugin unless a missing generic core seam is identified.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core design
options.body: Confirm the intended core boundary, service contract owner, lifecycle, and upgrade model before requesting a scoped implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep the workflow outside core
recommendation.body: Route service-specific orchestration and contracts to the appropriate owner repository or plugin unless a missing generic core seam is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history could not be inspected after the read-only sandbox failure, so no maintainer routing candidate beyond the proposal author is proven.
